translations.web: No one shall be weary nor stumble among them; no one shall slumber nor sleep, neither shall the belt of their waist be untied, nor the strap of their sandals be broken,
translations.bsb: None of them grows weary or stumbles; no one slumbers or sleeps. No belt is loose and no sandal strap is broken.
translations.kjv: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:
